items.requirement: Authorized soft-hold collection list (GET /reservations / Reservation::list) returns the full dump of currently visible soft-holds sorted by expiresAt ascending (earlier expiry first). Equal expiresAt may use any stable order. No stock or hold mutation on any path. Filters, paging, and DTO shape remain unchanged.
items.rationale: Sort order is the sole functional delta on an existing list surface; callers need a deterministic earlier-expiry-first dump without redefining the collection contract.
items.threshold: Authorized list always returns the same visible full dump as today, ordered by expiresAt ascending; ties use any stable order; never mutates stock or holds; no new filters, paging, or DTO fields.
items.measurement: OCL-derived Vitest contract tests plus OpenAPI exercises asserting expiresAt non-decreasing order on authorized list success (including empty and ties).

items.requirement: Reuse existing opaque-principal AuthZ Means (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ). Unauthorized list still fails with named UnauthorizedError; stock and holds are unchanged.
items.rationale: User ask keeps AuthZ unchanged; only sort order is added to the authorized success path.
items.threshold: Unauthorized list always fails with UnauthorizedError and never mutates; authorized opaque principal receives the shared visibility universe sorted by expiresAt ascending.
items.measurement: Existing UnauthorizedError contract tests remain green; cite POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ; no AuthZ surface rewrite.
